scope: Current production Maths Year 6-equivalent roster, entitlement distribution and canonical batch-source audit
privacy: Aggregate counts only; no student IDs, batch codes or credentials recorded in this evidence file.

currentRoster.interpretation: No current production student is simultaneously assigned to both an ordinary Year 6 Maths batch and an L3 Maths 11+ batch. The duplicate Year 6/L3 navigation observed in the browser is not caused by dual current enrolment.

l3AccessSourceAudit.interpretation: All current L3 students have canonical Y6 lesson entitlements because Year 6 and L3 share canonical lesson content. None had a Y6M51..Y6M69 SAT entitlement at audit time, so the duplicate Year 6 card was not caused by SAT access.

canonicalBatchSourceClassification.interpretation: Every audited canonical Y6 entitlement held by a current L3 student resolves through batch_definitions to an 11plus maths_level=3 source. These are L3 entitlements over shared canonical lesson IDs, not ordinary Year 6 enrolments.

rootCause.defectiveRule: The live catalogue overlay inferred normal-vs-11plus from whether the batch-code text contained the substring '11'.
rootCause.whyItFailed: Valid current L3 batch definitions are stream=11plus, maths_level=3 but their batch-code text is not required to contain '11'. The overlay therefore treated L3 canonical Y6 entitlements as ordinary Year 6 access, producing an open Year 6 alias while L3 appeared locked.
rootCause.correction: Live entitlement classification now joins batch_definitions and uses the canonical batch definition. Maths Year/L equivalent pairs are treated as one teaching curriculum for access while final navigation exposes only the student's programme label.

runtimeRuleValidatedByAudit.accessRule: Equivalent Maths Year/L presentations may share canonical lesson entitlements, but the home screen must expose one teaching-programme card only.
runtimeRuleValidatedByAudit.satsRule: SATS remains a separate navigation surface and does not create a second Year 6 teaching card.

productionRepair.verification: Preflight, forward-only deployment, live composition, runtime markers, shared Worker capabilities, bindings and live parent-email routing all passed.

closureBoundary: Production audit and forward-only deployment are complete. Owner browser verification of Devansh and representative ordinary Year 6/L3 students remains required before this incident is CLOSED PASS.
